left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients older than 18 years old
  -  Cerebral infarct within the anterior circulation due to occlusion of intracranial carotid artery or proximal (M1) MCA

right.raw_text: -  With acute MRI  [AND] performed within the first 24h and showing significant penumbra defined as ratio between the volumes of critically hypoperfused tissue  [AND] (defined by Tmax>6s) and the ischemic core (defined by ADC<600 × 10-6 mm2/s) of 1

left.raw_text: 8 or more, with an absolute difference  [AND] of 15 mL or more and ischemic core volume of less than 70 mL
-  Successful recanalization (TICI 2b-3) by thrombectomy alone  [OR] or in combination with IV thrombolysis (if within the first 4
-  Patient/Legally Authorized Representative has signed the Informed Consent form

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  History of symptomatic cerebral infarct  [AND] with functional deficit (pre-stroke modified Rankin Scale score ≥1) to measure the impact of the infarct  [AND] and selective neuronal loss on long-term outcome without being biased by pre-existing deficits

left.raw_text: -  History of severe cognitive impairment (dementia) [OR]  or DSMIV axis 1 psychiatric disorders that would confound the neurological evaluations
